clue.text: Avid reader's request for proof of credit standing

definitions.meaning: a keen reader might ask someone to hand over a volume
a bank or building society record book showing the account holder's balance

explanation.surface: A keen reader asks for evidence that their finances are sound.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as a phrase it is a plea to hand over a volume; as one word it is a savings account record.

clue.text: Heavenly Father has need of a temple

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
a heavenly being is a god

explanation.surface: God the Father needs a place of worship.
explanation.definitionFit: A pagoda is a tiered Buddhist or Hindu tower used as a place of worship.

clue.text: Pain produced by a needle

definitions.meaning: a sharp pain in the side
a loop of thread sewn with a needle

explanation.surface: A hurt caused by a sharp point.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden ache in the side shares a name with a sewn loop of thread.

clue.text: Amelia supporting large number of matches!

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting piece sits beneath the other

parts.note: big means large
Amy is a short form of Amelia

explanation.surface: Amelia backs a big match count.
explanation.definitionFit: Bigamy is marrying more than once at the same time, a number of marriages.

clue.text: Where dancing partner should never tread if alert

definitions.text: Where dancing partner should never tread

definitions.meaning: an idiom for being watchful and ready

explanation.surface: Advice on careful dancing and staying sharp.
explanation.definitionFit: Treading on feet is a dancing faux pas; the same phrase is an idiom for being watchful.

clue.text: Scales that any true centipede has

definitions.meaning: ... up, as in scaling a wall
a centipede would literally have C (a hundred) legs

explanation.surface: Something about the scales of an insect-like creature.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition reads the word as C LIMBS: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, which a 'centipede' should have.
explanation.definitionFit: Scaling is ascending; a hundred legs split as the Roman hundred plus limbs.

clue.text: Stop holiday cancellation

parts.note: leave is time off work
off means cancelled, as an event that is off

explanation.surface: Calling off a vacation.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave off is to cease doing something.

clue.text: Succeeded as a master craftsman

definitions.meaning: having done the work well, made skilfully

explanation.surface: A craftsman earns success.
explanation.definitionFit: To prosper is to make good; well-crafted work is well made.

clue.text: A tar and suet mixture used to make dripping

indicators.note: a mixture blends the letters of the words into a new order

explanation.surface: A recipe of suet and tar for producing cooking fat.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram needs 'tar'; 'car' is a scanning misread. 'Dripping' looks like cooking fat but means soaking wet.
explanation.definitionFit: To saturate something is to soak it so thoroughly it drips.

clue.text: Suspicious celebrations for the departing prodigal?

definitions.meaning: a son who is leaving, as in the biblical parable of the prodigal son

explanation.surface: Dodgy partying as the wasteful son heads off.
explanation.definitionFit: Shady events are shenanigans; a leaving offspring is a son on his way out.

clue.text: Sage found in India, also in a coal mine

indicators.note: the word for also sits inside the coal mine

parts.note: a pit is a coal mine
and means also

explanation.surface: A wise man is discovered both in India and down a mine.
explanation.definitionFit: A pandit is a learned Hindu scholar or wise teacher in India.

clue.text: Military centre is indeed evacuated

indicators.note: the clue's 'is indeed' reads as 'is in deed', placing the military centre inside the deed

parts.note: read as 'in deed', so the word deed is the container
a camp is a military base

explanation.surface: A military base really has been cleared out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'indeed' must be split as 'in deed': CAMP goes inside DEED.
explanation.definitionFit: Troops who decamp leave their position, emptying it.

clue.text: One who tends to tend the church

definitions.text: One who tends to tend the church

parts.words: One who tends to tend the church
parts.note: a church caretaker, playing on 'tends to' as 'leans towards' (verges on)

explanation.surface: A dutiful caretaker of a parish building.
explanation.definitionFit: A verger is the official who looks after a church's interior.

clue.text: Fishmonger's bargain for a miserly customer

parts.note: cheap means a bargain
skate is a fish a fishmonger sells

explanation.surface: A stingy shopper hunts for a deal at the fish counter.
explanation.definitionFit: A cheapskate is a stingy person who avoids paying.

clue.text: Where to get to a close up view in a theatre of war

definitions.text: Where to get to a close up view in a theatre of war

parts.words: Where to get to a close up view in a theatre of war
parts.note: the best spot in a theatre is near the stage; in a war it is the front line

explanation.surface: Advice on where to stand for the best view of a battle.
explanation.definitionFit: Front seats give the nearest view; in warfare the front is the front line of battle.

clue.text: Lead to a basement for a final confrontation

parts.note: to show someone the way is to lead them
down means towards a lower floor

explanation.surface: Guiding someone downstairs for the decisive clash.
explanation.definitionFit: A showdown is a decisive clash settling a dispute.

clue.text: Creating concoctions in the kitchen

indicators.note: a concoction mixes ingredients, so the letters are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: Making mixtures while cooking.
explanation.definitionFit: Catering is preparing and supplying food, work done in a kitchen.

clue.text: What a distant voyeur uses to ogle

definitions.text: What a distant voyeur uses to ogle

parts.words: What a distant voyeur uses to ogle
parts.note: the lens of a telescope or binoculars which a peeping person looks through

explanation.surface: A peeping Tom's equipment for staring from afar.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyepiece is the lens nearest the eye in a telescope.

clue.text: Lead in the world of pop music?

definitions.meaning: lead is a dense heavy element

definitions.text: in the world of pop music?

explanation.surface: A question about who leads in popular music.
explanation.definitionFit: Lead is a dense element; the same phrase names a loud rock genre.

clue.text: Conclude a telephone call leads to a personality problem

explanation.surface: Ending a call causes emotional trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: Replacing the receiver ends a call; the same phrase means a neurosis.

clue.text: Principles ladies spelt out

indicators.note: the letters are laid out afresh in a different order

explanation.surface: Women explain their values.
explanation.definitionFit: Ideals are standards or values one lives by.

clue.text: Levelled down to fourth class

parts.note: a grade is a class or rank
D is the fourth letter and the fourth grade

explanation.surface: Being demoted to the bottom class.
explanation.definitionFit: Graded ground has been made flat by a grader.

clue.text: White gives assistance to puppies

parts.note: helps means gives assistance

explanation.surface: A white dog helps out its young.
explanation.definitionFit: Whelps are young dogs, newborn pups.

clue.text: Maybe Manxman confesses to character assassination

parts.note: a confession is in the first person, so it supplies I
slander is the spoken defamation of someone's character

explanation.surface: A man from the Isle of Man owns up to defaming someone.
explanation.walkthrough: A Manxman lives on the Isle of Man, a self-governing island in the Irish Sea; 'Maybe' marks him as one example.
explanation.definitionFit: A Manxman is one example of an island dweller.

clue.text: Expressed view that card code should be printed in dictionary

indicators.note: the card code is to be set inside the dictionary's abbreviation

parts.note: OED is the Oxford English Dictionary
a PIN is the personal number for a bank card

explanation.surface: Someone argues that the bank card number belongs in the dictionary.
explanation.definitionFit: To opine is to state an opinion.

clue.text: The front man in the back of a security vehicle

indicators.note: the man is placed in the rear, after the vehicle

parts.note: a van is a vehicle used by security firms
guard means to man, staff or protect

explanation.surface: The lead person sits in the rear of an armoured truck.
explanation.definitionFit: The vanguard is the foremost part of an advancing army.

clue.text: Turn gun over to obtain a bit of gold

indicators.note: turning the gun over means writing it backwards

parts.note: get means obtain

explanation.surface: Someone turns a weapon round to grab some treasure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turn ... over' signals the reversal of GUN to NUG.
explanation.definitionFit: A nugget is a lump of gold found in nature.

clue.text: Sid's deep involvement is to be abhorred

indicators.note: an involved arrangement tangles the letters of the words into a new order

explanation.surface: Sid's deep part in something earns contempt.
explanation.definitionFit: To be despised is to be loathed or held in contempt.
